result.title: How Much Can We Prune? Exploring the Performance Limits of Visual Token Pruning
result.summary: Visual token pruning is increasingly used to reduce the memory and inference costs of vision-language models. Existing work has largely focused on designing method-specific selectors and demonstrating incremental improvements over prior methods at selected token budgets. It remains unclear whether the resulting performance reflects an inherent limit of visual token pruning or the limitations of current token-selection algorithms. We take a complementary perspective and ask: \emph{how well can visual token pruning perform when offline search cost is not the primary constraint?} We formulate pruning for general image understanding as selecting, under a fixed budget, one shared visual-token subset that supports a broad distribution of questions about an image. We approximate this utility with a finite auxiliary QA set generated by a frontier VLM and optimize a teacher-forced answer-probability objective with the evaluated model frozen. Motivated by the conceptual monotonicity and diminishing returns of adding visual evidence, we construct nested subsets greedily and introduce \emph{QA mini-batch greedy} (QA-MBG), which estimates token marginal gains from randomly sampled QA components at each step. Empirically, QA-MBG is both cheaper and more effective than full greedy. With one frontier-VLM call and approximately $0.5$ H100 GPU-hours per image, it produces a nested subset trajectory covering keep ratios up to $0.3$. Across Qwen3-VL-4B and Gemma~4 E4B on $900$ images from nine benchmarks, we find significant headroom over evaluated pruning baselines on held-out QA and image-grounded long-form generation, while the searched subsets substantially narrow the gap to full-token inference.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文探究视觉 token 剪枝的性能上限：把通用图像理解的剪枝建模为固定预算下选取一个共享视觉 token 子集，用前沿 VLM 生成的辅助 QA 集近似其效用，在被评估模型冻结下优化 teacher-forced 答案概率，并提出基于 QA 小批量的贪心方法 QA-MBG 构造嵌套子集，在九个基准上比较其与现有剪枝基线的差距。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接触及视觉证据筛选与预算—收益关系：其离线搜索得到的嵌套子集轨迹和 token 边际增益估计，可供核查 LVR 中 LOOK 保留多少视觉证据、剪枝是否为推理收益的主要瓶颈，以及现有剪枝方法离「上限」还有多远。
